about: Per-language ASR round-trip floors: Whisper-large-v3 CER on HUMAN speech
(FLEURS), from Fleurs-SLU App. A.5. A TTS round-trip number means nothing
except against its own language's floor — Danish's is more than double the
others, and one global threshold would silently hold Danish to an
impossible bar while letting English coast.
Gate: TTS_CER <= factor * floor, factor defaulting to 2.0, both numbers
